monetization.noteEs: Free-to-play con tienda de cosméticos (skins de armas y legends), Battle Pass por temporada (~$10 USD), y desbloqueo de legends pagable con currency premium o gradual con currency in-game. Sin packs que vendan poder — todos los legends son balance-equivalent al unlock.
monetization.noteEn: Free-to-play with cosmetic shop (weapon and legend skins), per-season Battle Pass (~$10 USD), and legend unlocks payable with premium currency or earned gradually with in-game currency. No packs sell power — all legends are balance-equivalent at unlock.
